name: Weekly Active Users (WAU)
description: WAU by week for the last 26 weeks, excluding internal accounts.

native.query:
SELECT date_trunc('week', last_seen_at) AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS wau
FROM analytics.user_activity
WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '26 weeks'
  AND is_internal = false
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

name: New Signups by Source
description: Daily new users by acquisition channel (UTM source).

name: MRR Trend (Net)
description: Net MRR movement by month (new, expansion, churn).

native.query:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', occurred_at) AS month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type='new' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS new_mrr,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type='expansion' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type='churn' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr
  FROM billing.mrr_events
  WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '18 months'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, new_mrr, expansion_mrr, churn_mrr, (new_mrr+expansion_mrr-churn_mrr) AS net_mrr
FROM m
ORDER BY month;

name: Overdue Invoices
description: Open invoices past due date with customer and amount.

native.query:
SELECT i.invoice_number, c.name AS customer, i.due_date, i.total_amount, i.currency
FROM billing.invoices i
JOIN billing.customers c ON c.id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.status='open'
  AND i.due_date < current_date
ORDER BY i.due_date ASC
LIMIT 500;

name: Top Search Queries (App)
description: Most common in-app search terms, last 30 days.

native.query:
SELECT lower(trim(query)) AS query, COUNT(*) AS searches
FROM product.search_events
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND query IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(query)) > 1
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY searches DESC
LIMIT 100;

name: API Error Rate by Endpoint
description: 5xx rate and count by route, last 7 days.

native.query:
SELECT route, COUNT(*) AS total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS error_pct
FROM observability.http_requests
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 200
ORDER BY error_pct DESC, total DESC
LIMIT 50;

name: Warehouse Inventory Aging
description: Inventory on hand grouped by age buckets.

name: Returns Rate by SKU
description: Return rate by SKU for shipped orders in the last 90 days.

native.query:
SELECT li.sku,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL) AS returned,
       COUNT(*) AS shipped,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS return_pct
FROM commerce.line_items li
JOIN commerce.shipments s ON s.id=li.shipment_id
LEFT JOIN commerce.returns r ON r.line_item_id=li.id
WHERE s.shipped_at >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 50
ORDER BY return_pct DESC, shipped DESC
LIMIT 200;

name: Support Tickets: SLA Breaches
description: Tickets that breached first response or resolution SLA in the last 30 days.

native.query:
SELECT t.id, t.subject, t.priority, t.status, t.created_at, t.first_response_at, t.resolved_at,
       t.sla_first_response_minutes, t.sla_resolution_minutes
FROM support.tickets t
WHERE t.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND (t.first_response_breached = true OR t.resolution_breached = true)
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

name: CSAT by Agent (Last 90 Days)
description: Average CSAT and response volume by agent.

name: Spend by Vendor (AP)
description: Accounts payable spend by vendor, last 12 months.

native.query:
SELECT v.vendor_name, SUM(p.amount) AS spend
FROM finance.ap_payments p
JOIN finance.vendors v ON v.id=p.vendor_id
WHERE p.paid_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY spend DESC
LIMIT 200;

name: Cash Runway Forecast
description: Runway estimate based on trailing 3-month net burn and cash balance.

native.query:
WITH burn AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_burn) AS avg_burn
  FROM finance.monthly_burn
  WHERE month >= date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '3 months'
), cash AS (
  SELECT balance AS cash_balance
  FROM finance.cash_balances
  WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM finance.cash_balances)
)
SELECT cash_balance, avg_burn,
       CASE WHEN avg_burn > 0 THEN ROUND(cash_balance/avg_burn, 1) ELSE NULL END AS months_runway
FROM cash, burn;

name: Marketing Funnel Conversion
description: Landing -> signup -> activation conversion by week.

native.query:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', ts) AS week,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event='landing_view') AS landings,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event='signup') AS signups,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FILTER (WHERE event='activated') AS activated
  FROM marketing.funnel_events
  WHERE ts >= now() - interval '20 weeks'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT week, landings, signups, activated,
       ROUND(100.0*signups/NULLIF(landings,0),2) AS landing_to_signup_pct,
       ROUND(100.0*activated/NULLIF(signups,0),2) AS signup_to_activation_pct
FROM w
ORDER BY week;

name: Campaign ROI (Last Quarter)
description: Spend vs attributed revenue by campaign for the last completed quarter.

native.query:
SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name,
       SUM(spend_usd) AS spend_usd,
       SUM(attributed_revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd,
       ROUND(SUM(attributed_revenue_usd)/NULLIF(SUM(spend_usd),0),2) AS roi
FROM marketing.campaign_performance
WHERE quarter = date_trunc('quarter', now()) - interval '1 quarter'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY roi DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 300;

name: Latency p95 by Service
description: p95 request latency by service over the last 24 hours.

native.query:
SELECT service, date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour,
       percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) AS p95_ms
FROM observability.service_latency
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY hour ASC;

name: Deployments per Day
description: Count of production deployments by day and team.

name: SOC2 Evidence: Admin Logins
description: Admin login events with IP and MFA status for evidence collection.

native.query:
SELECT occurred_at, actor_email, ip_address, mfa_used, user_agent
FROM security.admin_login_events
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '180 days'
ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
LIMIT 2000;

name: PII Access Audit (Last 30 Days)
description: Queries that touched PII-tagged tables, last 30 days.

native.query:
SELECT executed_at, user_email, table_name, rows_scanned, query_hash
FROM security.pii_access_audit
WHERE executed_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY executed_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;

name: Executive KPI Snapshot
description: High-level KPIs: WAU, MRR, churn, NPS (refresh daily).

name: Data Freshness: Critical Tables
description: Last updated timestamps for core marts and ingestion pipelines.

native.query:
SELECT table_name, max(updated_at) AS last_updated
FROM warehouse.table_freshness
WHERE table_name IN ('fct_orders','fct_subscriptions','dim_customers','fct_events')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 ASC;

name: Partner Referrals Pipeline
description: Leads and opportunities sourced by partners, current quarter.

native.query:
SELECT partner_name, stage, COUNT(*) AS deals, SUM(expected_arr) AS expected_arr
FROM sales.partner_pipeline
WHERE close_quarter = date_trunc('quarter', now())
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY expected_arr DESC;

name: Churn Reasons (Exit Survey)
description: Distribution of churn reasons from exit survey responses.

name: Product Adoption: Feature Flags
description: Adoption counts for key feature flags by workspace tier.

native.query:
SELECT tier, flag_key, COUNT(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS workspaces
FROM product.feature_flag_usage
WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY workspaces DESC
LIMIT 500;

name: Workspace Activation Cohorts
description: Activation within 7 days for new workspaces by cohort week.

native.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS cohort,
         workspace_id,
         MIN(CASE WHEN event='activated' THEN occurred_at END) AS activated_at
  FROM product.workspace_events
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 weeks'
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT cohort,
       COUNT(*) AS workspaces,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE activated_at <= (cohort + interval '7 days')) AS activated_7d
FROM c
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cohort;

name: DAU vs WAU Ratio
description: DAU/WAU sticky ratio with 7-day rolling average.

native.query:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', last_seen_at) AS day,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau
  FROM analytics.user_activity
  WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '120 days'
    AND is_internal = false
  GROUP BY 1
), w AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('week', last_seen_at) AS week,
         COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS wau
  FROM analytics.user_activity
  WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '120 days'
    AND is_internal = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT d.day, d.dau, w.wau,
       ROUND(d.dau::numeric/NULLIF(w.wau,0),4) AS dau_wau
FROM d
JOIN w ON date_trunc('week', d.day) = w.week
ORDER BY d.day;

name: Churned Customers (Last 60 Days)
description: Customers that churned, with plan, ARR, and churn reason if present.

native.query:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.company_name, c.plan, c.arr_usd, ch.churned_at, ch.reason
FROM billing.customer_churn ch
JOIN billing.customers c ON c.customer_id=ch.customer_id
WHERE ch.churned_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
ORDER BY ch.churned_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;

name: Feature Usage: Exports
description: CSV/PDF export volume by day and format.

name: Orders Shipped On Time
description: On-time shipment rate by carrier and week.

native.query:
SELECT date_trunc('week', s.shipped_at) AS week, s.carrier,
       COUNT(*) AS shipments,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_at <= s.promised_ship_date) AS on_time,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.shipped_at <= s.promised_ship_date)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS on_time_pct
FROM commerce.shipments s
WHERE s.shipped_at >= now() - interval '26 weeks'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY week;

name: Expense Policy Violations
description: Expense reports flagged by policy rules (amount, category, duplicates).

native.query:
SELECT report_id, employee_email, submitted_at, total_amount, violation_reason
FROM finance.expense_policy_flags
WHERE submitted_at >= now() - interval '120 days'
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
LIMIT 1000;

name: Email Deliverability Overview
description: Deliverability metrics by provider (SES, SendGrid) and day.

native.query:
SELECT date_trunc('day', sent_at) AS day, provider,
       COUNT(*) AS sent,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bounced=true) AS bounced,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE complained=true) AS complained
FROM marketing.email_events
WHERE sent_at >= now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY day;

name: Access Reviews: Pending
description: Outstanding quarterly access reviews by system and owner.

native.query:
SELECT system_name, reviewer_email, due_date, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM security.access_reviews
WHERE status='pending'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY due_date ASC;

name: Sales Cycle Time
description: Days from lead created to closed-won, grouped by segment.

native.query:
SELECT segment,
       percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_close) AS median_days,
       percentile_disc(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_close) AS p90_days,
       COUNT(*) AS deals
FROM sales.deal_cycle_times
WHERE closed_at >= now() - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY median_days ASC;

name: Onboarding Tasks Completion
description: Completion rate for onboarding checklist tasks by step.

name: Ticket Volume by Tag
description: Top tags on support tickets created in the last 14 days.

native.query:
SELECT tag, COUNT(*) AS tickets
FROM support.ticket_tags
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '14 days'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY tickets DESC
LIMIT 100;

name: Legacy Cohort Retention (Archived)
description: Old retention cohort query replaced by new model.

native.query:
SELECT cohort_week, week_number, retained_users
FROM analytics.retention_cohorts_legacy
WHERE cohort_week >= date_trunc('week', now()) - interval '52 weeks'
ORDER BY cohort_week, week_number;

name: Deprecated SLO Burn Rate
description: Superseded by multi-window burn rate dashboard card.

native.query:
SELECT window, burn_rate
FROM observability.slo_burn_rate_daily
WHERE day >= current_date - 30
ORDER BY day DESC, window;

name: Vendor Master Export (Removed)
description: Card removed from Metabase after finance schema migration.

native.query: SELECT * FROM finance.vendors ORDER BY vendor_name;
